title: Lapis Bloom
description: Seven layers of kueh, shaped into a scalloped flower. Grooved bands and a raised floral top make this a little desk keepsake.
printNote: Flat-back print · swap colours at 2.2, 4.4, 6.6, 8.8, 11 and 13.2 mm.

title: Tutu Keychain
description: A tiny scalloped kueh on its green leaf, now with a reinforced eyelet to carry a little Singapore everywhere.
printNote: Flat-back print · green to white at 3 mm. Add a metal keyring; strength and fit untested.

title: CHOPE Desk Marker
description: The familiar tissue packet, made into a playful desk marker inspired by Singapore’s seat-reserving custom.
printNote: Flat-back print · coral to white at 10 mm for a simple two-colour finish.

title: HDB Block Pencil Pot
description: A miniature neighbourhood for your pencils. Recessed windows and a BLK 01 sign turn a small tower into a familiar home.
printNote: Upright print · 50 × 26 mm opening with a 4 mm floor.

title: Kopitiam Paperclip Cup
description: A little kopi cup and saucer to catch the small things on your desk. A nod to the everyday coffee break.
printNote: Base-down print · 11 mm deep well; for desk storage, not drinks.

title: Peranakan Tile Coaster
description: An original floral pattern inspired by the decorative tiles of Singapore’s shophouses, in blue and warm ivory.
printNote: Flat-back print · colour change at 4 mm; heat and stability untested.

title: Ice Cream Wafer Card Stand
description: Wafer, pink ice cream, wafer. A familiar street-side treat becomes a compact home for a note or name card.
printNote: Base-down print · 1.6 mm slot; colour changes at 5 and 21 mm. Light cards only.

title: Kaya Reveal
description: A toast-shaped sliding fidget with a bright kaya-and-butter middle. An early idea for a familiar breakfast ritual.
printNote: Visual concept only. Retaining rails, clearances and sliding mechanism are not engineered.
